name: Workhorse news
responsibility: A turn on one of the tab session's workhorses that ended or began waiting on the user, whoever started it, as one plain sentence that names its checkout
description: Read from each workhorse thread's own turn/completed and thread/status/changed notifications: completed, failed, stopped or waiting, and a message from tell_coordinator. The sentence names the checkout of the workhorse, which is the one argument every workhorse tool takes, and carries no identity; the coordinator reads the rest through inspect_workhorse.
